run_audio_transcription: run speech-to-text transcription on an uploaded audio file using a HuggingFace model
create_transcription_handler: create a TranscriptionHandler instance for handling POST /v1/audio/transcriptions requests
stream_audio_transcription: stream real-time transcription output from an audio file using server-sent events
prepare_audio_inputs: prepare audio file bytes into model-ready input tensors with librosa and processor
validate_transcription_request: validate multipart form fields in a transcription request and reject unexpected parameters
